exact_accounting_recalculation.independent_method: Python Decimal summation and multiplication from the exact packed monthly quantities and pinned factor, with no intermediate rounding and half-up display rounding only at four decimal places.

report_contract.determinism: For fixed verified M59 archive bytes and fixed synthetic company name, report bytes and SHA-256 are identical.
report_contract.print_behavior: A fixed print header and footer repeat the complete status string on every printed page; @page margins reserve header and footer space.
report_contract.lineage: All twelve periods retain their state and evidence or treatment. The report exposes packed source names, hashes and locators; the November reason, formula and basis months; the December exclusion reason and null treatment; exact factor/method/GWP authority; and both M57 and M58 bounded internal decisions with IDs, outcomes, reason codes, warning acknowledgments, actors and timestamps.

acceptance_evidence.evidence: Creation revalidates stored M59 bytes, reconstructs the current archive from the approved database lineage, requires byte-equivalent current archive input and invokes the strict M59 verifier before report construction. Fixed inputs produce byte-identical HTML and digest. Changed archive bytes fail before rendering.

Every read verifies the stored M59 pack, reconstructs the current pack, rebuilds the canonical report and compares profile, every pack/inventory binding, byte length, digest and exact report bytes. A privileged coordinated change to report bytes, digest and length returns a bounded 503. SQL also independently recomputes SHA-256 over report bytes at insertion.

Independent Decimal arithmetic matches all reported, estimated and included subtotals. The twelve-row report preserves ten reported months, November's named estimation reason/formula/basis and December's null quantity/emissions plus exclusion reason; excluded activity is not presented as zero or included in the subtotal.

The report reads lineage exclusively from the already verified pack. It exposes period source names, hashes and locators, factor/method/GWP identifiers and source hash, both bounded internal review records and the archive/manifest/lineage/inventory hashes. It explicitly denies assurance, certification and filing approval.

Owner/admin creation and member read/download are enforced by API and SQL. Members cannot create; outsider reads return 404 and signed-out reads return 401. Both report and audit tables force RLS, use tenant-bound foreign keys, deny direct authenticated writes and reject update/delete. Malformed and stale requests fail without a report.

Browser metadata decoding binds exact IDs, profile, hashes, size and timestamps. Current-report reload uses the selected actor, accepts only exact pack/inventory-bound metadata and maps a tenant-safe 404 to no report. Downloads verify response length, server hash header and a fresh browser SHA-256 over bytes. The HTML has one main/h1, ordered headings, captioned tables, textual state labels, wrapping for long values, print-safe table blocks and repeating fixed print status header/footer with reserved page margins. Application status/error output retains live-region semantics.

Workspace create/revisit clears annual registers, annual inventory, evidence-pack metadata, local ZIP, replay receipt and draft-report metadata before the request. Every actor change clears the same state before another identity can revisit. A member can reload the report through the member token, an outsider receives no report metadata, and signed-out access cannot reuse or display the prior actor's report state. The visible milestone heading now identifies M60 and its verified-evidence-to-readable-draft outcome.

The server requires cumulative M54-M60 flags plus development/test runtime, and the browser module is lazy-loaded only behind the exact seven-feature gate. The ordinary production JavaScript/HTML contains none of the M60 profile, flag, route, exact total, report heading or synthetic-report markers. The report remains synthetic, incomplete, unreleased, release-ineligible and without assurance or filing claims.

findings.finding: The initial read path accepted a coordinated stored report-byte, digest and length change because it did not rebuild the canonical report.
findings.resolution_evidence: Every read now reconstructs the current M59 archive, rebuilds the M60 report and requires exact byte and metadata equivalence. The coordinated mutation probe returns 503.

findings.finding: The initial report omitted both review decisions and material source/factor lineage.
findings.resolution_evidence: The exact packed M57 and M58 decisions, period sources, hashes and locators, estimation/exclusion treatments and factor/method/GWP authority now render with claim-safe internal-review language.

findings.finding: The initial warning notice appeared only once and did not keep the required status visible on every printed page.
findings.resolution_evidence: A fixed print header and footer repeat the full draft/synthetic/incomplete/unreleased/no-assurance/release-false status, with reserved @page margins and focused contract assertions.

findings.finding: After the first passing review, a later role-switch check found that M58/M59/M60 browser state was not comprehensively cleared or reloaded, allowing stale report metadata from a prior actor to remain in memory.
findings.resolution_evidence: Current create/revisit and actor-change paths clear every annual, evidence-pack, local-file, replay-receipt and draft-report value before further work. The strict current-report reader sends only the selected actor credential, binds returned metadata to the exact inventory and pack, returns null for the tenant-safe outsider 404, and refuses all other non-success responses. Focused browser tests pass for member reload, changed binding rejection and outsider absence; signed-out state is cleared before its authenticated workspace request can fail.

limitations: Persistence and RLS execution evidence uses PGlite, not hosted Supabase/PostgreSQL. Hosted extension availability, grants and operational behavior require a later deployment-stage review.
All company, activity, source and identity data is fixed and synthetic. No customer data was used.
The report is deterministic HTML. Cross-browser print-engine pagination, physical printer output, PDF conversion and long-term archival rendering were not exhaustively qualified.
The reviewer inspected semantic and print CSS and exercised automated accessibility boundaries, but a separate manual assistive-technology session was not performed in this review turn.

M60 presents an incomplete, unreleased location-based Scope 2 development draft. It does not cover market-based Scope 2, Scope 1, Scope 3, filing formats, evidence authenticity, professional assurance, deployment or release.
